# PROCESS — cand_0004

Reader target: `aws/claude-haiku-4-5`, mid tier. Every behavioral rule that could be
skipped was moved into tool code; only calibration judgement stayed in prose.

## Diagnosis

74 usable trajectories in `./trajectories/` (case-013__t1 excluded — `score.raw =
{'errored': …}`, TimeoutExpired, reward 0.0). Dumped the boolean-check *rationales*
first, before reading any transcript — one cheap pass that exposed a fully
deterministic cluster three prose-only iterations had missed.

Reward decomposition used for ranking (denominator 52): each of 8 booleans = 4,
`rfe_quality` = 3/point, `revision_quality` = 2/point.

## Ranked clusters → edit → verify

| # | Cluster (root cause) | Cost | Edit | Class | Verify |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| B1 | Review frontmatter self-contradiction: `auto_revised: false` while `before_score != score` (006-t1, 015-t2, 016-t0, 017-t1); `pass: true` beside `recommendation: autorevise_reject` (016-t0, 017-t1); `pass: false` with total 9 and no zero (006-t1). cand_0003 addressed this in **prose** inside `rfe.review` Step 4, which the mid-tier reader skips and which never runs when Step 4 short-circuits. | 7 boolean failures ≈ 0.0073 val | **E1** — deterministic `python3 -c` invariant repair as `## Step 0.5` in `rfe.submit/SKILL.md` (runs last, after every review cycle, and every Jira label in that skill's own table derives from exactly these fields). `rfe.review` 4f slimmed to the one script it must run + a pointer to Step 0.5; `rfe.auto-fix` Teardown given a "never hand-edit, Step 0.5 does it" line. | boolean, deterministic | Ran the block **extracted verbatim by regex** from the shipped `SKILL.md` over 298 real review artifacts: **289 OK / 9 REPAIRED** — fires on every known failing file, no-op on every passing one. Then end-to-end on a hand-corrupted file (`score 9, before_score 10, pass false, autorevise_reject`): printed `REPAIRED … {'pass': 'true', 'auto_revised': 'true', 'recommendation': 'submit', 'needs_attention': 'true'}` and left the clean control byte-identical. |
| B2 | `run_report_exists`: death in the REVIEW wave with no defined recovery. `Any other exit code is an error.` gave no next step, and "Wave recovery" was scoped to the ASSESS wave only; 024-t2 substituted Teardown for the rest of the loop from phase REVIEW. | 2 boolean failures ≈ 0.0021 val | **E1c** — that sentence replaced with an explicit `set-phase REPORT` + `run-phase` guard, plus a hard rule: never end the loop from any phase other than `DONE`; `batch_summary.py` is not a substitute. | boolean, deterministic | Traced `scripts/pipeline_state.py`: `REPORT` is in `PHASES` (l.90), `set-phase` dispatch accepts it (l.1435), and `generate_run_report.py` is invoked only from the REPORT phase entry (~l.409). The forced transition is a legal path to the artifact. |
| Q1 | `rfe_quality` stuck at 4: **55 fours = 56 lost points ≈ 0.044 val, the largest single pool of headroom.** All 18 fives had a 10/10 self-score. Prescriptive HOW inside `## Acceptance Criteria` / `### In Scope` is the top *actionable* deduction (30 mentions, 30 of them primary), and 18 of those cases already had good WHY. | ≈ 0.044 val | **E2** — new "Open-to-HOW rule" section in `rfe.create/rfe-template.md` (no byte budget), matching the file's existing WRONG/RIGHT style: a technology may name the domain; inside an AC only as `(e.g., …)` with an alternative, or as the pre-existing component operated against; **never** the subject/object of an AC; `### In Scope` lists capabilities, never mechanisms (bans base class, abstraction/registry, design pattern, framework, transport, method signature, field name, version pin, latency number). **E3** — `review-agent.md` §4.1c, a 4-step reconciliation chain for `scores.open_to_how` mirroring the already-working §4.1b `right_sized` chain. | quality, generalizing | The template already had an Evidence rule and a Framing rule but **nothing** for `open_to_how` — this is the missing third leg, not a re-statement. §4.1c explicitly does **not** fire on a technology mentioned in title/Summary/Problem Statement, so it cannot lower a currently-correct 2/2 (SAFE). |
| Q2 | `revision_quality`: 5 threes, 25 fours ≈ 0.018 val. All 5 threes are revisions that rewrote `Affected Customers` / `Business Justification` with fabricated narrative. **All 44 fives are non-revisions** — the judge rewards not touching WHY over touching it badly. 4 of the fours are the same `before_score` drift B1 fixes. | ≈ 0.018 val | **E4** — `revise-agent.md`: "Reframing the WHY is not fixing the WHY" 2-step chain (add verbatim evidence only if the assessor/ticket/architecture context supplied it; otherwise leave `None identified` / `No revenue impact` alone, set `needs_attention=true`, spend the edit on HOW framing) + explicit never-do list (generalized «redacted» narrative, derived quantities like `40 engineer-hours/month`, restating an internal need as customer-facing). Vendor carve-out scoped to title/Summary/Problem Statement only, with a WRONG/RIGHT AC pair. **E3** — `review-agent.md` §4.1d (never raise a score a revision did not earn; no "Exemplary RFE" while a criterion is below 2) and a rewritten §4.2 requiring `needs_attention_reason` to name the criterion, what would raise it, **and why automation cannot raise it here**. | quality, generalizing | Every rule points at *not* editing, so it cannot degrade a non-revision (the 44 fives) — SAFE by construction. |

## Byte budget (`.skillsaw.yaml`: warn 4000, error 8000)

| Skill | Seed | Now |
| - | - | - |
| rfe.review | 13282 | **13063** (−219, below seed as required) |
| rfe.speedrun | 9534 | 9511 (untouched) |
| rfe.auto-fix | 6872 | 7045 |
| rfe.submit | 3131 | 6350 |
| rfe.create | 7999 | 7999 (untouched) |
| rfe.split / rfe-feasibility-review | — | 6940 / 6605 (untouched) |

The full repair script first went into `rfe.auto-fix`, which blew the 8000 error line
(8821B, still 8144B after four rounds of trimming). Relocating it to the under-budget
sibling that actually consumes those fields solved the budget *and* put it at the right
point in the pipeline. All 7 frontmatter blocks parse with unchanged key sets;
all 7 `description:` fields now contain "Use when" (`rfe.submit`'s previously read only
"Use after /rfe.review." — the validator-warning shape cand_0001 was penalized for).

## Features / subagents used

Two read-only `Explore` subagents fanned out over the trajectory groups (boolean-failure
rationales; `revision_quality` + `run_report_exists`). Edits were applied directly —
the five edits touch five disjoint files, so worktree isolation would have bought
nothing but merge overhead.

## Preserve

- `rfe.submit` **Step 0.5** verbatim. It is the only deterministic enforcement of the
  frontmatter contract; every prose version of it has failed.
- `review-agent.md` §4.1 two-scales table and §4.1b — these landed the earlier gains.
- The honest-gap mechanism (`None identified`, `needs_attention_reason`) throughout.

## Skipped, deliberately

The 3 `revision_coverage` failures on `revision-expected`-tagged cases (023-t2, 024-t0,
024-t2). The honest-gap mechanism is already in place; closing them needs the review
pass threshold raised, which `INSIGHTS.md` already records as net-negative.
